data.title: 欧根亲王 · 铁血战舰甲板的夕阳军姿
data.description: 巡航归港的铁血战巡舰桥甲板上，壮阔的夕阳将海面与钢铁舰体染得一片金红。欧根身穿严整而挺拔的铁血军官军服，帅气的外套大衣披在双肩。海风烈烈扬起她的发丝，她双手扶着舰桥护栏，神情自信威严，转过头来注视着并肩同行的指挥官，眼神中满是纵横重洋的绝对信赖与只为你展现的娇媚反差。
data.action: standing at ship bridge railing against burning sunset over ocean, naval officer uniform coat draped over shoulders, wind whipping hair, confident charming smirk looking at viewer
data.location: battleship command deck overlooking vast ocean during fiery golden sunset
data.lighting: intense fiery orange sunset backlighting naval steel and flowing hair
data.mood: commanding naval majesty, romantic maritime grandeur
data.promptProse: Standing on the warship command deck as the sun sinks into the sea, Prinz Eugen wears her iron-blood naval officer coat draped over her shoulders. The evening sea wind catches her hair as she looks back with a proud, affectionate smirk.
data.animaCaption: Prinz Eugen standing on a warship deck at sunset in her naval officer uniform, smirking confidently.
